description: Source code for DNS message packing and unpacking functions within the Zephyr project, including handling of DNS questions, answers, and message headers.

methods.name: dns_strlen
methods.description: Calculates the length of a string, returns 0 if input is NULL.

methods.name: dns_msg_pack_qname
methods.description: Packs a domain name into DNS message format.

methods.name: set_dns_msg_response
methods.description: Sets response type, position, and length in dns_msg_t structure.

methods.name: skip_fqdn
methods.description: Skips over an encoded FQDN in DNS message, returns size or error.

methods.name: dns_unpack_answer
methods.description: Unpacks a DNS answer from message, extracts TTL and type.

methods.name: dns_unpack_response_header
methods.description: Unpacks and validates DNS response header.

methods.name: dns_msg_pack_query_header
methods.description: Packs DNS query header with transaction ID.

methods.name: dns_msg_pack_query
methods.description: Constructs a DNS query message with question name, type, and class.

methods.name: dns_find_null
methods.description: Finds null terminator in DNS name label sequence.

methods.name: dns_unpack_response_query
methods.description: Unpacks DNS query section from response message.

methods.name: dns_copy_qname
methods.description: Copies a domain name from DNS message to buffer, handling compression.

methods.name: mdns_unpack_query_header
methods.description: Unpacks mDNS query header, retrieves source ID.

methods.name: dns_unpack_name
methods.description: Unpacks a domain name from DNS message, handling compression pointers.

methods.name: dns_unpack_query
methods.description: Unpacks DNS query from message, validates type and class.
